summary.business_type: Consumer fintech (digital wallet, QR payments, consumer lending / earned-wage-access) - Azerbaijan market - YMYL
top_findings: 5 of 8 linked pages (/about-us, /instant-loan, /instant-advance, /offers, /partner-terms) serve byte-identical duplicate homepage content instead of their own content, confirmed via matching ETag/Last-Modified/title/H1 across two independent HTTP clients
Universal soft-404: any invalid URL (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, wp-admin, random paths) returns HTTP 200 with the homepage body instead of HTTP 404
Zero interest rate / APR / fee disclosure anywhere in crawlable content for Instant Loan or Instant Advance products
Title tag and meta description are 100% identical across all 8 discovered URLs
No canonical tags anywhere; www.payonix.com and payonix.com both resolve directly with HTTP 200 with no redirect
quick_wins: Enable gzip/brotli compression (confirmed completely absent on HTML and JS even when explicitly requested)
Add long-lived Cache-Control to hashed /_next/static/* assets (currently none set)
Make the 5 FAQ answers visible in the DOM (currently 0 words of answer text exist for any of them)
Add Organization JSON-LD using data already on the page (logo, social links, contact point)
Open port 80 and 301-redirect to HTTPS (currently no listener on port 80 at all)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS enforced with valid wildcard certificate (Sectigo, *.payonix.com, valid to 2026-11-29)
HSTS present: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
No accidental noindex on rendering pages
DOM size (~407 elements) well under the 1,500-element INP concern threshold
google-site-verification meta tag present

findings.title: 5 of 8 nav-linked pages serve duplicate homepage content instead of their own
findings.description: /about-us, /instant-loan, /instant-advance, /offers, /partner-terms all return identical ETag "6a44fff8-bcaf", identical Last-Modified, identical 48303-byte length, and identical <title>/<h1> to the homepage. Cross-verified with Invoke-WebRequest and curl.exe independently.
findings.recommendation: Locate and fix the reverse-proxy/CDN catch-all rule (likely an nginx try_files/rewrite meant for a pure SPA) that serves a cached homepage for any unrecognized path before it reaches the Next.js app's own routing.

findings.title: Universal soft-404 across the entire domain
findings.description: Any invalid path (/wp-admin, /deep/bogus/path/xyz) returns HTTP 200 with the homepage body and matching ETag instead of HTTP 404.
findings.recommendation: Implement proper 404 status codes at the layer producing the fallback; verify Next.js's own not-found boundary (already present in the app's React tree) is actually reachable.

findings.title: robots.txt does not exist
findings.description: /robots.txt returns Content-Type: text/html and the homepage body (same ETag as homepage) instead of a real robots file.
findings.recommendation: Publish a real robots.txt (text/plain) with a Sitemap directive once the soft-404 fallback is fixed.

findings.title: sitemap.xml does not exist
findings.description: /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml both return the homepage HTML with status 200.
findings.recommendation: Generate and publish an XML sitemap listing all real, working URLs; submit in Search Console.

findings.title: No canonical tags anywhere
findings.description: Zero <link rel="canonical"> tags found across all fetched pages.
findings.recommendation: Add a self-referencing canonical tag to every page.

findings.title: www and non-www both resolve without redirect
findings.description: https://www.payonix.com/ and https://payonix.com/ both return HTTP 200 directly with no 301/302 between them.
findings.recommendation: Pick one canonical host and 301-redirect the other to it.

findings.title: Port 80 has no listener; HTTP requests fail outright instead of redirecting
findings.description: http://payonix.com/ fails to connect; Test-NetConnection on port 80 returns TcpTestSucceeded: False.
findings.recommendation: Open port 80 and issue a 301 redirect to the HTTPS equivalent URL, standard practice for links/bookmarks missing the https:// prefix.

findings.title: No response compression on HTML or JS assets
findings.description: Explicit Accept-Encoding: gzip, br, deflate requests still returned an empty Content-Encoding header on both the 48,303-byte homepage HTML and a /_next/static/chunks/*.js asset.
findings.recommendation: Enable gzip/brotli at the nginx layer for text-based MIME types.

findings.title: No Cache-Control on immutable hashed static assets
findings.description: A /_next/static/chunks/*.js request (content-hashed filename, safe to cache forever) returned no Cache-Control header at all.
findings.recommendation: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable to all /_next/static/* responses.

findings.title: Missing standard security headers
findings.description: Only Strict-Transport-Security is present; X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and Content-Security-Policy are all absent.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing security headers at the reverse-proxy layer.

findings.title: Server version disclosed in headers
findings.description: Server: nginx/1.18.0 (a ~2020-era release) is sent on every response.
findings.recommendation: Set server_tokens off; in nginx and evaluate upgrading.

findings.title: manifest.json, site.webmanifest, apple-touch-icon.png all fall through to the soft-404 fallback
findings.description: All three well-known paths return status 200 with the homepage body instead of their expected content types.
findings.recommendation: Add real PWA manifest and touch-icon files once the soft-404 fallback is fixed.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: /privacy-policy (870 words) and /customer-terms (4,692 words) are both substantial and appear genuine
Regulatory license disclosure (Central Bank of Azerbaijan, license EPT-016) present in the footer of every page, verified correct at the raw byte level
Homepage testimonials include specific, non-generic details (exact amounts, timeframes)

findings.title: 5 of 8 pages have zero unique content
findings.description: About Us, Instant Loan, Instant Advance, Offers, and Partner Terms all render the homepage instead of their own content (same root cause as the Technical SEO duplicate-page finding).
findings.recommendation: Fix the underlying routing/proxy bug, then populate each page with real, unique content.

findings.title: No interest rate, APR, or fee disclosure in crawlable content
findings.description: The only on-site mention of 'interest rates' is inside a customer testimonial ('...also very competitive compared to the market'), not an actual disclosure of terms.
findings.recommendation: Publish real rate/fee/repayment-term figures as visible text on the (fixed) Instant Loan and Instant Advance pages.

findings.title: FAQ answers are entirely absent from the DOM
findings.description: All 5 FAQ questions render with a '+' toggle button but zero accompanying answer text exists anywhere in the page source.
findings.recommendation: Add real answer text (target 134-167 words per answer for optimal AI-citability) visible in the markup, not only revealed via client-side interaction.

findings.title: Meta description misrepresents the target audience
findings.description: 'Secure and innovative payment solutions for businesses of all sizes' describes a B2B offering, but Payonix is a consumer (B2C) app per its own hero copy.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the meta description to accurately reflect the consumer audience and core value proposition.

findings.title: About Us page has no actual content
findings.description: The primary E-E-A-T page (company story, team, values) renders the homepage instead (same root cause as the duplicate-page finding).
findings.recommendation: Once routing is fixed, write ≥400 words of unique company narrative per standard About-page content gates.

findings.title: No author/team identity anywhere on the site
findings.description: No named staff, credentials, or leadership bios found on any crawlable page.
findings.recommendation: Add leadership/team presence to the About Us page to strengthen Expertise and Authoritativeness signals.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Every page has an H1 (inherited from the homepage on the broken pages)
Clean, descriptive URL slugs with no query-string clutter
Logical information architecture (nav + footer + homepage cards) even though several destinations are currently broken

findings.title: Title tag identical across all 8 URLs
findings.description: Every page shows 'Payonix - Next-Gen Payment Solutions' verbatim.
findings.recommendation: Write a unique, 30-60 character title per page with the primary term near the front.

findings.title: Meta description identical across all 8 URLs
findings.description: Every page shows the same generic B2B-sounding description.
findings.recommendation: Write a unique, 120-160 character description per page.

findings.title: No canonical tags (on-page view of the technical finding)
findings.description: See Technical SEO category.
findings.recommendation: See Technical SEO category.

findings.title: Zero Open Graph or Twitter Card tags
findings.description: Regex sweep of the homepage source found 0 matches for 'og:' or 'twitter:'.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, og:image, and twitter:card meta tags for proper social share previews.

findings.title: Title tag carries no differentiating keywords beyond the brand name
findings.description: No mention of 'instant loan,' 'salary advance,' 'Azerbaijan,' or 'QR payment' in the title.
findings.recommendation: Incorporate a primary descriptive term alongside the brand name.

findings.title: Nav 'Contact' link points to '/' instead of the working #contact-us anchor
findings.description: The homepage does have a working id="contact-us" anchor further down the page, but the nav link ignores it.
findings.recommendation: Point the nav 'Contact' link to /#contact-us or a dedicated /contact page.

findings.title: Language switcher has no observable effect on crawlable output
findings.description: A language-switcher button exists in the header but triggers no visible URL change or hreflang tags.
findings.recommendation: Either implement real localized URLs with hreflang tags, or confirm the control is intentionally cosmetic-only.

findings.title: Zero structured data of any kind on the site
findings.description: Regex sweep for 'application/ld+json' across the homepage returned 0 matches; no Microdata or RDFa found either.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD (name, logo, contactPoint, sameAs to the 4 existing social profiles) and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD for the mobile app. Do not add FAQPage (Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites 2026-05-07) or QAPage (wrong fit for a 5-item marketing FAQ).

categories.name: Performance
what_works: 11 of 12 script tags load async, minimizing render-blocking JS
Images predominantly use next/image with explicit dimensions for CLS control
4 fonts preloaded via <link rel="preload">
SVG-heavy icon/illustration strategy is inherently lightweight
DOM size (~407 elements) is well under the 1,500-element INP concern threshold

findings.title: No compression on HTML or JS responses
findings.description: Duplicate of the Technical SEO finding: Content-Encoding is empty even when explicitly requested.
findings.recommendation: Enable gzip/brotli at the server layer.

findings.title: No long-lived caching on immutable static assets
findings.description: Duplicate of the Technical SEO finding.
findings.recommendation: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable to /_next/static/* responses.

findings.title: Real LCP/INP/CLS field and lab data unavailable this session
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights keyless API quota returned 429 Too Many Requests on both attempts (including after a 15-second backoff). The 48/100 score above is an estimate from direct HTTP/HTML evidence only, not a Lighthouse run.
findings.recommendation: Configure a free PageSpeed Insights API key (Tier 0 credential) and re-run to obtain real Lighthouse + CrUX numbers.

findings.title: FAQ answers absent from the DOM (biggest citability gap)
findings.description: Duplicate of the Content Quality finding: self-contained Q&A pairs are exactly what AI Overviews/LLMs prefer to cite, and none exist in crawlable form.
findings.recommendation: Publish visible answer text targeting 134-167 words per answer.

findings.title: No entity/Organization structured data
findings.description: Duplicate of the Schema finding; weakens entity recognition for AI systems building a knowledge graph of the brand.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD with sameAs links.

findings.title: No substantive, citable page describing the company or its loan terms
findings.description: Because /about-us and /instant-loan are non-functional, there is no AI-answer-friendly prose anywhere describing what Payonix does or its actual loan terms.
findings.recommendation: Fix the underlying routing bug and populate both pages with real, citable content.

findings.title: No llms.txt present
findings.description: Not prioritized as an action item: llms.txt is not a confirmed AI-citation lever per current primary-source evidence; Google Search does not consume it.
findings.recommendation: No action needed on this specific point.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 64 of 64 tags have alt attributes - zero missing
Alt text is descriptive rather than generic filenames or keyword-stuffed
Consistent use of next/image with explicit dimensions or fixed containers for CLS control
Predominantly SVG for icons/illustrations; PNG reserved for photographic content

findings.title: Testimonial avatar photos and phone-mockup image use PNG rather than a modern format
findings.description: /t-1.png, /t-2.png, /t-3.png, /p-1.png observed in source instead of WebP/AVIF.
findings.recommendation: Re-encode photographic PNG assets to WebP/AVIF for marginal byte savings.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix routing/hosting so /about-us, /instant-loan, /instant-advance, /offers, /partner-terms render their own content instead of the homepage
Implement real HTTP 404 handling for invalid paths
Add a real robots.txt with a Sitemap directive
Generate and publish an XML sitemap
Disclose loan/salary-advance interest rate, fee schedule, and repayment terms as real visible text
Add canonical tags site-wide and resolve www vs. non-www with a 301

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Write unique title and meta description for all 8 pages
Add Open Graph and Twitter Card tags
Enable gzip/brotli compression
Add long-lived Cache-Control to hashed static assets
Open port 80 and issue a real 301 redirect to HTTPS
Make the 5 FAQ answers visible as real text

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add Organization JSON-LD (name, logo, contactPoint, sameAs)
Add SoftwareApplication JSON-LD (aggregateRating only if sourced from real store data)
Build out real About Us content (≥400 words)
Add standard security headers
Suppress nginx version banner and evaluate upgrade
Clarify the language-switcher UX (real hreflang or confirm cosmetic-only)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Configure a PageSpeed Insights API key and re-run for real Lighthouse/CrUX data
Connect/monitor Google Search Console weekly for soft-404/duplicate-content regressions
Re-crawl monthly to confirm the 5 previously-broken pages continue rendering correctly
Convert testimonial/photo PNGs to WebP/AVIF
Add manifest.json, apple-touch-icon.png, and security.txt once the soft-404 fallback is fixed

artifacts.note: Per-category findings are consolidated into FULL-AUDIT-REPORT.md rather than split into separate findings/ files; no screenshot capture was performed in this session (no Playwright/browser tooling available).

limitations: No Google Search Console / GA4 / CrUX API access available in this session - real indexation status, click/impression history, and field CWV data not verified
PageSpeed Insights keyless API quota exhausted (429) on both attempts - Performance score in this report is a manual estimate from HTTP/HTML evidence, not a Lighthouse run
No backlink profile analysis performed (Ahrefs/Moz/DataForSEO/Common Crawl not available) - recommend as a separate follow-up pass
Crawl scope limited to 8 pages discovered via homepage/footer navigation; no sitemap existed to cross-reference against, so orphan pages without inbound internal links would not have been discovered

An initial hypothesis of character-encoding corruption in Azerbaijani-language legal/footer text was investigated via raw byte-level inspection and disproved - the served bytes are valid, correct UTF-8. This was an artifact of the audit session's own tooling and is not included as a finding.
